opportunities.buyer_job: New RV owner needs a source-linked maintenance evidence trail
opportunities.query_cluster: RV maintenance log book; RV maintenance handbook

opportunities.buyer_job: Solo sewist needs a usable self-fitting triage sequence
opportunities.query_cluster: sewing fitting book; pattern fitting book

evidence.summary: Nine bounded observation-first cards were screened through purchase, scenario, accessible-gap, independence, rights, expertise and timing gates.
Twenty-two external observations from four source families were stored with dated interpretation and alternative explanations in the evidence cards.
Five candidates were deep checked; only RV reached evidence-backed concept status and sewing remains watch-only.

decisions.reason: Independent purchase and request evidence support a physical record, while buyer complaints identify a guided evidence-system gap beyond blank logs.
The buyer problem and physical-book preference are real, but original visual production and expert QA feasibility remain unproven.
